Name: Survivalistic Addon files
Author: Dojando
Description:
I wanted to make more mods compatible with the Survivalistic Mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/109604218]Ophaneom[/url].
So I searched my mod folder for all the mods that add something edible and created content packs for their mod.

All values were added by hand, so no automatic script was used. That means that every food item has its own, customized values for filling the bar. That way I hope it will be more or less immersive. However some items may or may not feel unbalanced. either they will not add enough or too much to the bars. If you feel something should be buffed or nerfed, please let me know! :)

Installation:
In the ZIP-File you download are JSON files. 
Each mod, that adds food items has its own JSON file.
You put each JSON file you want into the following folder:
"Stardew Valley\Mods\Survivalistic\assets\Databases"

If you want any other mod to be added, just tell me! :)
